solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Cheer for the Spanish in brother's dance

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other, the cheer within the brother

parts.note: BRO is a short informal form of brother
OLE is the Spanish shout of approval, heard at bullfights

explanation.surface: A Spanish cheer rings out during a sibling's dance.
explanation.definitionFit: A bolero is a lively Spanish dance in triple time.

clue.text: Excess fat gets bras out of shape and causes astonishment

parts.note: flab is surplus body fat

indicators.note: out of shape says the letters of the two words before it are bent into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone's spare flesh pushes their underwear out of shape, to general amazement.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads 'Excess fat' as one phrase about bodies; it gives the first piece, and 'out of shape' scrambles only the next two words into BERGASTS.
explanation.definitionFit: To flabbergast someone is to astonish them utterly, so the verb forms match.

clue.text: Nut or tomato, for example, on something baked

parts.note: botanically a tomato is a fruit
a cake is something baked in an oven

explanation.surface: Asks whether a nut or a tomato might go on top of a bake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nut' looks like a food but is slang for a crazy person; the tomato is botanically a fruit, which is the convention the clue leans on.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are informal terms for an eccentric or crazy person.

clue.text: More dismissive of broadcast that's finally over

parts.note: to air a programme is to broadcast it
i.e. stands for id est, that is

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word that follows it

explanation.surface: Someone grows more scornful of a programme once it has ended.
explanation.definitionFit: Airy can mean casual and offhand, so the comparative describes someone more dismissive.

clue.text: Exclude winning golf shots — they're used to get concessions

parts.note: to bar someone is to exclude them
gaining means winning or acquiring
chips are short lofted shots in golf

explanation.surface: Ruling out winning golf shots, as if they were a negotiating tactic.
explanation.definitionFit: Bargaining chips are assets offered in negotiation to extract concessions from the other side.

clue.text: Right deal includes a good supplier of clobber

indicators.note: includes says the outer pieces hold the inner ones within them

parts.note: trade means to deal in goods

explanation.surface: A fair bargain brings in a good provider of gear.
explanation.walkthrough: CLOBBER is British slang for clothes, so the RAG TRADE (the clothing industry) supplies it.
explanation.definitionFit: The rag trade is an informal name for the clothing and fashion business, which supplies garments.

clue.text: A complete collection, including last of series, is a thing of value

indicators.note: including shows the collection word wraps around the extra letter

parts.note: a set is a full collection of items

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A full box set, with the final series included, is worth having.
explanation.definitionFit: An asset is something useful or valuable that one owns.

clue.text: French turn up supporting pedigree amphibian!

indicators.note: supporting in a down clue places these pieces beneath the pedigree word

parts.note: a family tree records a pedigree

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a go is a turn in a game

explanation.surface: Exclaims that a French amphibian of good breeding has appeared.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns GO into OG; 'supporting' puts FR and OG below TREE in the column.
explanation.definitionFit: A tree frog is a small climbing amphibian living in trees.

clue.text: Grim smell with no discernible origin

indicators.note: no discernible origin says the opening letter of the smell word is lost

parts.note: odour means a smell

explanation.surface: An unpleasant smell whose source nobody can trace.
explanation.definitionFit: Dour means stern, gloomy and severe in manner.

clue.text: Make a mental note of list

definitions.meaning: to take notice of something and fix it in the mind
an official record or roll of names

explanation.definitionFit: Register is both a verb for noticing and remembering and a noun for an official list.

clue.text: Area with no boundaries — note to call on the way to bed

indicators.note: no boundaries strips the first and last letters from the word before

parts.note: ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
to ring someone is to call them

explanation.surface: Instructions for leaving an area without fences, and leaving a message for someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Retiring means going off to bed for the night.

clue.text: Confirm shaft must contain suitable return

indicators.note: must contain shows the shaft word wrapping around the other piece

parts.note: a ray is a shaft of light

indicators.note: return says the suitable word comes back in reverse order

parts.note: fit means suitable

explanation.surface: A demand that a shaft be built to give a fitting yield.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shaft' suggests a mine, but here it is a beam of light; 'return' sends the suitable word backwards before it goes in.
explanation.definitionFit: To ratify an agreement is to confirm it formally.

clue.text: Instrument for deciphering Cretan icon

indicators.note: deciphering means working the letters out of their coded order into a new one

explanation.surface: Someone is decoding an ancient icon from Crete.
explanation.definitionFit: A concertina is a small hexagonal bellows-driven musical instrument.

clue.text: Intimidating woman's long haul in operation

parts.note: a drag is a long tedious stretch, a haul
on means working or in operation

explanation.surface: A formidable woman finds the long journey a grind while working.
explanation.definitionFit: Dragon is a colloquial term for a fierce, domineering woman.

clue.text: Flat section in area — people start tipping

parts.note: a part is a section
men can mean people in general

indicators.note: start takes the opening letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A section of a flat in the district, as people begin tipping.
explanation.definitionFit: An apartment is a flat, a self-contained set of rooms.

clue.text: Where one may get off scot-free?

definitions.text: Where one may get off scot-free?

parts.words: Where one may get off scot-free?
parts.note: scot is an old word for a tax, so a place free of scot is one where little duty is levied, not just one where criminals escape

explanation.definitionFit: A tax haven is a country with very low taxes where people can avoid paying much tax.

clue.text: Carpet made from skin by head of class

indicators.note: head of takes the leading letter of the following word

parts.note: a hide is an animal's skin

explanation.surface: A rug made from an animal skin hangs by the teacher's desk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Carpet' is a verb here: to carpet someone is to reprimand them.
explanation.definitionFit: To carpet someone, as an employee called in, is to scold or rebuke them.

clue.text: Does better with bronzes and winches on ship

parts.note: to cap something is to outdo it
to bronze is to tan in the sun

explanation.surface: Someone outdoes others with bronze medals and ship's winches.
explanation.definitionFit: Capstans are revolving drums on ships used for hauling ropes and cables.

clue.text: One shoots beer drinkers drinking last of ale

indicators.note: drinking says the beer drinkers take in the following letter

parts.note: CAMRA, the Campaign for Real Ale, is a British organisation of beer drinkers

indicators.note: last of takes the final letter of the following word

explanation.surface: A drinker downs beer while others in the group take a swig of ale.
explanation.walkthrough: CAMRA is the British Campaign for Real Ale, a consumer group of beer enthusiasts; E goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera shoots photographs or film.

clue.text: Regret a pun that's tricky but novel!

indicators.note: tricky suggests the letters are juggled awkwardly into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone apologises for a pun that was clever but original.
explanation.walkthrough: 'novel' looks like an adjective meaning new but is a noun, a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A page-turner is an exciting book, typically a novel, that one cannot put down.

clue.text: Pair, say, up in pain

parts.note: to twin is to pair one thing with another

indicators.note: up in a down clue says the word reads from the bottom upwards

parts.note: e.g. means for example, as say does

explanation.surface: Two people, for instance, are in pain together.
explanation.definitionFit: A twinge is a sudden sharp pang of pain.

clue.text: Bug?

parts.note: the noun means an insect, while as a verb bug means to listen in secretly, which the question mark invites

explanation.definitionFit: An earwig is an insect, and to earwig is to eavesdrop, as a bug does.

clue.text: Ship carrying white wine causes a sensation

indicators.note: carrying shows the ship letters holding the wine inside

parts.note: SS stands for steamship
hock is a German white wine from the Rhine

explanation.surface: A ship's cargo of white wine creates a stir.
explanation.definitionFit: Shocks, as a verb, means startles or causes a sensation in people.

clue.text: Is unable to love melody in music

parts.note: can't means cannot, is unable to
love is zero in tennis, written as O

explanation.surface: Someone can't bring themselves to love a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Canto in music is the melody or principal voice part, from the Italian for song.

clue.text: Left mother in risky act of prayer

indicators.note: in places the left and mother letters within the risky word

parts.note: hairy is informal for dangerous or risky
ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: A mother left alone takes a risk and prays.
explanation.definitionFit: A Hail Mary is a Catholic prayer to the Virgin, so saying one is an act of prayer.

clue.text: England manager with girl — one man who's a control freak!

parts.note: Sven-Goran Eriksson managed the England football team
gal is informal for a girl
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: England's football boss with a girlfriend is one who must control everything.
explanation.walkthrough: SVEN is Sven-Goran Eriksson, the Swede who managed England's national football team from 2001 to 2006.
explanation.definitionFit: A Svengali, after the hypnotist in du Maurier's Trilby, is someone who manipulates and controls another.

clue.text: Digital protection for pin

definitions.meaning: the hard covering at the tip of a finger, which protects the digit
a metal spike hammered in to fasten things

explanation.definitionFit: Nail names both a fingernail shielding the fingertip and a metal fastener like a pin.

clue.text: One's instinct is developed but haphazard

indicators.note: developed suggests the letters grow into a different arrangement

parts.note: the word one's gives its letters including the S

explanation.surface: A person's gut feeling, once worked on, turns out to be random.
explanation.definitionFit: Inconsistent means erratic or irregular, as anything haphazard is.
